headline: Caribbean Yacht Charter
primaryText: Luxury Yacht Charter In the Caribbean
description: Sea Bliss, a Sunreef 70 sailing catamaran, is chartering across Antigua and Barbuda this season. Four cabins, crew of three.
whyItWorks: Bright turquoise water, white sand and the yacht itself sell the escape before any copy is read. Each card shows a different part of the trip (snorkeling, paddleboarding, the private chef, cabins), so people can picture themselves aboard and swipe to see more. Every card points to the same Sea Bliss page, which keeps the path to booking simple for a high-ticket, niche audience.
